a1160.reason: The body said the Lutheran churches 'have held to these two [sacraments] ever since, while retaining confession as a non-sacramental practice'. The Apology of the Augsburg Confession (1531), itself a Lutheran confession, calls Baptism, the Lord's Supper and Absolution 'truly Sacraments', and Lutheranism has not been dogmatic about the number. The body now says Lutheran churches generally count two (as the EKD does) though some count three, and the notes accept 3 as an alternative answer.
